title: Railway RRB NTPC Graduate Level CEN No. 06/2025 Recruitment 2025 CBT-I Result/ Cutoff/ Score Card 2026 Out for 5810 Post
intro: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has Officially Released CBT-I Result/ Cutoff/ Score Card for the Post of Non-Technical Popular Category (NTPC) Graduate Level (CEN: 06/2025) Recruitment 2025for 5810 Post. Exam Held On March 16-27, 2026 & CBT-I Result/ Cutoff Available On  June 11, 2026. All Registered Candidates Can Download CBT-I Result/ Cutoff/ Score Card Now in the Given Link Below..
importantDates: Last date for Application fee payment for the submitted application : 29 November 2025
Exam Admit Card: 4 Days before Exam
General / OBC  Candidates : Rs.500/- (Rs. 400/- Refunded After Appear Stage I Exam)
SC / ST / PH/ All Female Candidates : Rs. 250/- (Rs. 250/- Refunded After Appear Stage I Exam)
Payment Mode: Pay the Exam Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode Only.
Read the Notification for Age Relaxation.
Age Relaxation Extra as Per Rules.

Important Instruction for the All Candidates Expect the Fee Concession Categories.
Candidates Must be Enter the Your Account Number, Account Holder Name, IFSC Code Under Login Section.
Railway Will be Refunded General/ OBC/ EWS Candidates Rs. 400 & SC / ST Candidates Rs. 250/-
After the Appear the First Stage CBT Examination Your Exceed Amount Will be Refunded at Your Bank.
Note : If you have Not Appeared in CBT Exam Amount Not be Refunded.
